blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball second round MANILA, Philippines—La Salle leaned on its backcourt duo of Doy Dungo and Jacob Cortez to beat University of the Philippines, 88-80, and boost its Final Four bid on Sunday night at Araneta Coliseum. Dungo and Cortez turned in 22 points each and combined for seven triples, helping the Green Archers clinch at least a playoff for a semifinals slot and tie the Far Eastern University Tamaraws for the last two Final Four spots. “We’re such a talented team, but if we don’t have team chemistry, that’s all for nothing,” said Cortez, whose squad […]...
